description: This Kotlin source file defines a RecyclerView adapter named TopNavAdapter used for a top navigation bar in an Android TV app. It manages a list of navigation category items, including a special search item, providing focus handling, visual feedback, and click interactions tailored for TV remote navigation.

classes.name: TopNavAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying top navigation items with focus and click handling suited for Android TV. Supports a special search item token and animates focus changes.

classes.name: TopNavAdapter.TopNavVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class managing individual navigation item views, handling binding, focus animations, and key events.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Submits a new list of items to the adapter for display, leveraging ListAdapter functionality.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and inflates a new ViewHolder for a navigation item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to a ViewHolder for a specific position.

methods.name: TopNavVH.bind
methods.description: Configures the item view with text or search icon, sets focus and click handlers, and manages key events for navigation.
